items.title: Zerodha's FY26 net profit rises 1.2% to Rs 4,283 crore amid revenue slowdown
items.description: Zerodha's net profit increased by 1.2 percent to ₹4,283 crore in FY26. Revenue remained largely unchanged from the previous year's ₹8,847 crore. Income from margin trading helped offset a slowdown in its core broking business. Smaller rival Groww expanded both revenue and profit by about 14 percent. Zerodha remains nearly twice as large on key financial measures.
